corrections.reason: Both legs of 6th-order ስ are present on the image, matching the parallel Amharic contrastive particle 'ያስ የመካከለኛውስ ያስ ከነዚህ ልዩ ነው'.
The canonical Ge'ez word in John 19:23 is 'ዘእምላዕሉ' ('from the top') printed with triangular ዕ, which was misread as እ.
The printed glyph is 6th-order ስ in the standard reciprocal phrase 'እርስ በርሳቸውም' ('among themselves'), not 2nd-order ሱ.
